{{Quote|There's a moon eight parsecs from here with nobody home.|Arvel Skeen|<ref name="The Eye" />}}
An uninhabited '''moon''' existed eight [[parsec]]s from the [[moon]] [[Frezno]].<ref name="The Eye" /> Around 5 BBY,<ref name="Date">"[[The Eye]]," in which the [[Aldhani heist|mission on Aldhani]] occurs, takes place [[Standard day|days]] after "[[Kassa (episode)|Kassa]]," which dates itself to [[5 BBY]].</ref> the [[Aldhani rebel infiltration team]]—including [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], [[Karis Nemik]], [[Vel Sartha]] and [[Arvel Skeen]]—[[Aldhani heist|stole]] eighty million [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] from the [[Galactic Empire]] base inside the [[Aldhani dam]] on the planet [[Aldhani]]. During the team's escape, Nemik was injured when he was crushed by a pallet of credits. The surviving members of the team traveled to Frezno to have Nemik's injuries treated by [[Doctor]] [[Quadpaw]]. During the operation, Skeen attempted to convince Andor to abandon the other team members to travel to the moon and split the credits stolen during the mission between the two of them; however, Andor refused and [[Death|killed]] Skeen.<ref name="The Eye" />

==Behind the scenes==
The moon was first mentioned in "[[The Eye]]," the sixth episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the streaming series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'','' written by [[Dan Gilroy]] and directed by [[Susanna White]].<ref name="The Eye" />
